defects: Hex strings passed to interpolate_color cause a startup AttributeError under Manim CE 0.19.
Important coordinate and continuation-boundary labels project behind the opaque caption bands or outside the frame.
feedback:
Repair the scene source. In attempts/004-scene-candidate.json content lines 11–15, palette constants are strings. The first landscape reaches skin() line 71 before any shot: CE 0.19 interpolate_color calls color1.interpolate(color2, alpha), which raises AttributeError for these strings. This dispatch failure was independently reproduced. Convert the palette constants to ManimColor objects before defining helpers, or convert both operands at every interpolation call, including lines 71, 78 and 327. See the tagged implementation: [CE 0.19 color helper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ManimCommunity/manim/v0.19.0/manim/utils/color/core.py).

Reposition labels in critical_strip() lines 228–233 and proof_geometry() lines 390–419. The opaque margins at lines 435–442 leave a visible world band approximately -2.63 < y < 2.59. Source-based projection places the critical-line label at y=-3.117 during the RH beat. More seriously, the beta_*-epsilon_* label remains below y=-3.17 throughout its appearance in the climax, while beta_* reaches y=2.828 at 196 seconds. These labels are masked even after the startup repair. Move their anchors into the visible band or use compact linked callouts, checking the entire camera path. These are calculated projections using the [tagged Cairo camera](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ManimCommunity/manim/v0.19.0/manim/camera/three_d_camera.py), not rendered observations.

The mathematical and structural checks otherwise passed: four zero residuals below 1.3e-14; independent 90-digit Euler-transformed eta comparisons within 6.7e-14 at nine points; image-loop winding 1.0; synchronized points share segment interpolation; frontier displacement and final affine power are correct. The source parses, uses only permitted imports, schedules exactly 220 seconds, preserves known-zero positions, and distinguishes the manuscript assertion from full RH. Its planned surfaces, curtains, paired loops, lifted lattice and continuation volume provide genuine 3D compositions.
limitations: No rendering, editing or delegation was performed. No actual frames were supplied; visual assessment concerns source-defined composition.
